decisions.reason: Here the Chemical Bath doesn't cool the hot ingots that need HV (only Kanthal, at MV; the rest need the Vacuum Freezer). Its HV jobs are lens dyeing (480 EU/t) and Ender Eyes, so the text says that.
desc:
The &3HV Chemical Bath&r dyes Glass Lenses with &aChemical Dye&r (a dye, Sulfuric Acid and Salt reacted in a Chemical Reactor). Coloured lenses let you engrave more types of Wafers.

It also turns Ender Pearls into &5Ender Eyes&r with molten Blaze, and you'll want plenty of those for &6HV&r Emitters and Sensors.

decisions.reason: Cut the TFG meta line about seeing more TecTech later in that pack.
desc:
You now have access to two &3new Maintenance Hatches&r. 

The &3Automatic Maintenance Hatch&r is pretty simple - it eliminates the need for Maintenance, &6forever&r.

The &3Configurable Maintenance Hatch&r is more interesting. You can configure it to cut off &a10%% duration&r on recipes, at the cost of making Maintenance happen three times as fast. That is &d16 real hours&r of activity. Additionally, you can use it on Multiblock Generators to increase the duration of the recipe, which indirectly increases their fuel efficiency by 10%%!

&9Reminder:&r You can put Tape in the maintenance Hatch to automatically fix problems.
{@pagebreak}
&l&3Lore:&r&o The Automatic Maintenance Hatch texture and mechanic comes from TecTech, an addon mod originally made for GregTech: New Horizons.

decisions.reason: TFG's components use its Vitrified Ender Pearls; here HV Emitters/Sensors use an Ender Eye (+ chromium rods), motors 2 silver double cables + electrum wire + magnetic steel, the rest gold cables. Electrotine isn't an ore here. Tips rewritten with verified sources: blaze powder from carbon + sulfur (HV chemical reactor, 480 EU/t), electrum mixer, mercury bath byproducts of TFC-derived crushed ores (copper/magnetite/silver -> gold, gold -> silver), mercury from cinnabar.
desc:
Just like &bMV&r, you'll need to make higher-tier components.

The &dFlawless Emeralds&r of MV Emitters and Sensors are replaced with &dEnder Eyes&r. Also notice that the &aMotors&r require &d2x Silver Cables&r and &dElectrum&r wire, while most of the other parts, the &aHull&r and the &aMachines&r use &dGold Cables&r.

Finally, a use for that stockpile of Gold!
{@pagebreak}

&9&lTips to make life less painful:&r

- &eEnder Eyes&r: craft an Ender Pearl with &eBlaze Powder&r, which an &6HV&r Chemical Reactor makes from Carbon and Sulfur dust.
- &eElectrum&r is Gold and Silver dust in a &3Mixer&r.
- Bathe crushed Copper, Magnetite or Silver ore in &dMercury&r in the &3Chemical Bath&r for bonus &eGold&r, and crushed Gold ore for bonus &eSilver&r. Mercury comes from centrifuging Cinnabar.

decisions.reason: Removed the rocket (Ad Astra). Listed what the HV Assembler (480 EU/t) makes here: SMDs, Nichrome coils, the HV Energy Hatch.
desc: The &3HV Assembler&r is the next step in progression. It makes the &aSMD components&r, &aNichrome Heating Coils&r and the &6HV&r Energy Hatch, among other things - check around this quest for more.

decisions.reason: Apatite and spessartine lenses aren't in this pack. Simple SoC wafers use #c:lenses/cyan and LPIC wafers #c:lenses/orange, which here are only the dyed glass lenses (HV Chemical Bath). LPIC cutting is 480 EU/t in a cleanroom (verified).
desc:
You'll want to grab these two lenses, dyed in the &3HV Chemical Bath&r. The &3Cyan&r lens engraves &aSimple System on Chip&r wafers, used for the best &8ULV&r Circuit recipe, while the &6Orange&r lens engraves the &aLPIC&r Wafer required for your next Energy Hatch.

Cutting LPIC wafers into chips takes an &6HV&r Cutter inside your &3Cleanroom&r.

decisions.reason: No AE2 here, and nothing in Create uses ULV circuits. Here NAND chips go into the LV electronic circuit (2x #gtceu:circuits/ulv); one Simple SoC gives 8 (phenolic) or 12 (plastic board).
desc: &8ULV&r Circuits stand in for Vacuum Tubes: every &7LV&r Electronic Circuit made in the Circuit Assembler takes two. One Simple SoC becomes 8 &aNAND Chips&r on a Phenolic board, or 12 on a Plastic board, which makes this the cheapest ULV circuit by far.

decisions.reason: Ilmenite comes from TFC magnetite here (kubejs/startup_scripts/ore_byproducts.js); bauxite has no source.
desc:
Titanium requires a slightly more &binvolved&r process than the previous materials. To get started, you'll need &aRutile&r. An &3EBF&r reduces &aIlmenite&r dust with Carbon to Rutile.

Ilmenite comes from TFC &aMagnetite&r: run crushed magnetite through a &3Thermal Centrifuge&r, or centrifuge pure magnetite dust, and ilmenite is the &6Byproduct&r.

Once you've gotten enough &5Rutile&r, your journey to &6Titanium&r continues in the next quest. There's no need to rush things.

decisions.reason: Magnesium recovery here is magnesium chloride + sodium in a chemical reactor (no MgCl2 electrolysis), then salt electrolysis returns sodium and chlorine; carbon monoxide electrolyzes to carbon + oxygen. TiCl4 polymer boost is LCR-only (4320 vs 2160 x 1.5 = 133%, verified). Titanium from TiCl4 comes out as a hot ingot.
desc:
To get your grubby hands on some Titanium, &aRutile&r must first be reduced to &aTitanium Tetrachloride&r with Carbon and Chlorine in an &3HV Chemical Reactor&r, then reduced again in an &3EBF&r with &dMagnesium&r to finally arrive at Titanium. The ingots come out hot, so they need the &3Vacuum Freezer&r.

The &dCarbon&r, &dChlorine&r, &dOxygen&r, and &dMagnesium&r can all be recovered: electrolyze the &dCarbon Monoxide&r back into Carbon and Oxygen, and react the &dMagnesium Chloride&r with Sodium in a Chemical Reactor for Magnesium and Salt, which electrolyzes back into Sodium and Chlorine. With that loop running, &athe only material&r that you'll need to provide for Titanium is &dRutile&r!
{@pagebreak}

&aTitanium Tetrachloride&r also acts as a catalyst in the &3Large Chemical Reactor&r's polymer recipes. A touch of &aTiCl₄&r can increase the polymer yield to &6133%%&r. Naturally, this is completely optional.

decisions.reason: Here titanium is 1,941 K (dust) / 2,141 K (TiCl4), so Kanthal coils are enough; Nichrome (3,600 K) is needed for MBCC superconductor (3,300 K), tungstensteel (3,000 K) and tungsten (3,600 K). Deps on TFG's desh foil and chorus insulation (Moon) replaced: the coil is made in the HV Assembler (8 nichrome double wire + 8 stainless steel foil + aluminium).
desc:
&3Nichrome Heating Coils&r bring your &3Electric Blast Furnace&r up to &d3,600K&r.

Titanium only needs Kanthal coils, but the hotter recipes ahead need these: the &6HV&r Superconductor (3,300K), Tungstensteel (3,000K) and Tungsten (3,600K).
{@pagebreak}
&l&3Lore:&r&o In the original GregTech 5, there were only three types of coils. This was the last tier.

decisions.reason: Titanium doesn't need Nichrome coils here (2,141 K max), but its hot ingots need the Vacuum Freezer. TFG's Energy chapter maps to this book's power chapter.
desc:
&aTitanium&r has the highest corrosion resistance and strength-to-density ratio of any metallic element, so it's only natural that we'll be using it as the main material in our &5EV&r machinery.

Confirm that your closed loop for &aRutile&r is up to standard, and prepare to run a dedicated &3EBF&r for hours.

A quick aside - now that we're heading to &5EV&r, single block generators are about to fall out of style! They stop at &6HV&r, so you'll need to run several &3HV Generators&r to keep up - later, upgrades to Multiblock Generators will be required.

While Multiblock generators are much more expensive, you'll find them to be much more energy efficient! Have a look at the power chapter for more info!

decisions.reason: No Mars or AE2. Verified: the only HV-tier circuit assembler recipes are the Microprocessor Mainframe (IV), and the EV Circuit Assembler needs 2 IV circuits. Recipe needs EV circuits and an HV emitter, so deps point there instead of the dropped vitrified pearl.
desc:
The next &3Circuit Assembler&r. This tier is only required for one Circuit: the &aMicroprocessor Mainframe&r, your first &1IV&r Circuit, whose main use is building the &5EV Circuit Assembler&r.

You can put this off until &5EV&r or simply just use it for faster circuit making.

decisions.reason: tfg:vitrified_pearl (TFG item, pyrolyse oven with TFG insulation) isn't in the pack; HV parts here use Ender Eyes instead.

No Moon (Helium-3, lunar bedrock veins). Bedrock fluid veins are GregTech's own and aren't removed by the pack (only ore veins are). The recipe takes an HV emitter and sensor, so it depends on the components instead of the dropped vitrified pearl.
desc:
This prospector boasts a &6higher range&r than its &7LV&r counterpart.

Sneak right-clicking with the Prospector in your hand will change its mode to &6Fluid Vein Mode&r. This will instead display the base &dyield&r of the bedrock Fluid veins below you, along with how full they are.
{@pagebreak}

&9Reminder:&r The yield of a &3Fluid Drilling Rig&r is directly proportional to the "fullness" of the vein. When low enough, the output will default to a yield that can be defined in the CEu config.

&9Tip:&r When the fullness drops below 30%% (alright, rough estimate), you should consider moving to another vein for the sake of power-to-yield efficiency. Aiming for the &3Advanced Fluid Drilling Rig&r in &5EV&r may interest you, as not only does it significantly boost the output, but it also reduces the rate at which it drains the vein!

decisions.reason: No lepidolite/bastnasite/mica veins or Moon here. Verified: TFC topaz (in TFC 4 it generates in volcano fissures) macerates into GregTech crushed topaz, topaz dust electrolyzes to fluorine; biotite (stone dust centrifuge byproduct) also electrolyzes to fluorine.
desc:
Fluorine is the rarest gas to obtain from electrolysis in this game.

Your best source is &aTopaz&r: TFC's topaz forms in the fissures at the heart of volcanoes. The Macerator turns it into crushed Topaz ore; process that into dust and electrolyze it.

&aBiotite&r, one of the byproducts of centrifuging Stone Dust, also gives some.

decisions.reason: Verified: TNT only from gelled toluene + sulfuric acid (no crafting recipe); HV chemical reactor gives 20 gelled toluene per bucket vs 10 from the fluid solidifier; implosion compressor takes 1 industrial TNT = 4 TNT = 8 powderbarrels = 2 dynamite. 'Heavy Oil Residue' doesn't exist here: the distillery makes toluene from Heavy Fuel or Wood Tar (pyrolyse oven).
desc: Get ready to make some explosives, as they will be required for the &cImplosion Compressor&r. Four kinds work: Powderbarrels, &cTNT&r, &dIndustrial TNT&r and Dynamite. One Industrial TNT does the work of four TNT, so we advise you to work towards it whenever you can.
{@pagebreak}

&cTNT&r (Trinitrotoluene) can't be prepared with the usual Gunpowder and Sand anymore. Instead, you'll have to produce &aGelled Toluene&r and react it with Sulfuric Acid to make TNT.

Using the &3HV Chemical Reactor&r recipe (Toluene, Sugar and Polyethylene dust) will double the yield of &aGelled Toluene&r compared to the Fluid Solidifier.
{@pagebreak}

We don't have any easy tips to give you for &aToluene&r. It's going to be tricky no matter which route you take.

That being said, don't miss out on the direct &aHeavy Fuel&r and &aWood Tar&r to &aToluene&r recipes in the single block &3Distillery&r. Wood Tar comes from logs in the &3Pyrolyse Oven&r.

&aToluene&r can also optionally be used in &5EV&r to make &dGasoline&r.

&cTNT&r is used in the &3Implosion Compressor&r to make Gems. It also blows stuff up.

decisions.reason: Removed TFG/Beneath lore; ae2:ender_dust isn't in the pack, replaced by gtceu:ender_pearl_dust. Verified: HV mixer (480 EU/t) beryllium + 4 potassium + nitrogen -> ender pearl dust, implosion compressor -> ender pearls; beryllium from emerald electrolysis (TFC emerald), potassium from rock salt (TFC sylvite) or saltpeter.
desc:
GregTech can make Ender Pearls from scratch.

Mix &2Beryllium Dust&r, &2Potassium Dust&r and &bNitrogen&r in an &6HV&r Mixer to create &5Ender Pearl Dust&r, then throw it into an &7Implosion Compressor&r to recreate the iconic Ender Pearl - GregTech style.

Beryllium comes from electrolyzing Emerald dust, Potassium from electrolyzing Rock Salt (TFC's Sylvite) or Saltpeter.

decisions.reason: The phosphorus boule's EBF recipe has no cleanroom condition here; cutting the boule and engraving its wafers do (verified).
desc:
Doping is the process of intentionally introducing impurities into semiconductors to alter their properties.

&7Polysilicon&r can be doped with small amounts of &ePhosphorus&r to make a better &eSilicon Boule&r.

Phosphorus-doped Silicon Boules typically yield &68 times&r more wafers than their non-doped counterparts. However, they are not strictly needed until &5EV&r, where they'll be used in more complex wafers.

&9Note&r: Cutting Phosphorus Boules and engraving their Wafers require a &dCleanroom&r.

decisions.reason: Replaced the pointer to TFG's LV Oxygen quest with the oxygen sources themselves. Recipes verified (LCR nitrogen dioxide from elements; chemical reactor NO2 + oxygen + water).
desc:
Nitric Acid's fumes are extremely toxic! It's also a very potent oxidizer.

&aNitric Acid&r is used in:

&9-&r Cetane-Boosted Diesel, a better Diesel fuel that you'll get to soon.
&9-&r The optional gem slurry chains.
&9-&r The Platinum Group Sludge chain.
&9-&r Polybenzimidazole (try saying that ten times fast!) in &1IV&r.
{@pagebreak}

There are two main ways to make &aNitric Acid&r - &othe &agood&f way and the &4bad&f ways!&r

Therefore, we'll point you towards the best method:

Get a &3Large Chemical Reactor&r and use it to make &aNitrogen Dioxide&r. From there, react it in a regular &3Chemical Reactor&r with more &dOxygen&r and &dWater&r and you got yourself some &aNitric Acid&r!

This requires a lot of &dOxygen&r, so make sure your electrolysis keeps up. Notice that this is Hydrogen free!

decisions.reason: Fuel value checked: in the combustion generator cetane-boosted diesel runs 45 ticks per unit vs diesel's 15, i.e. three times as long (TFG said +180 percent). Mixer recipe is 480 EU/t, so it depends on the HV Mixer too. Ethenone/acetic acid routes and the circuit-2 warning verified.
desc:
Now that you unlocked the &6HV&r Mixer and have access to &eNitric Acid&r, it becomes possible to make &aCetane Boosted Diesel&r, which burns three times as long as plain Diesel in a Combustion Generator.

The only tricky part is obtaining &bTetranitromethane&r. We recommend producing it by reacting &9Nitric Acid&r and &dEthenone&r. Ethenone itself isn't hard to make if you combine &9Sulfuric Acid&r - which you should have plenty of by now - and &cAcetic Acid&r, easily produced from &3Oxygen&r and &5Ethylene&r.

&cDon't forget&r to set your machine on Circuit 2, or else you'll end up producing &6Polyethylene&r instead!

decisions.reason: No platinum veins here. Verified route: purified tetrahedrite (TFC) + nitric acid -> platinum group sludge; centrifuge with aqua regia (480 EU/t) -> raw platinum -> electrolyzer. SMD diode = gallium arsenide + platinum fine wire + polyethylene. DOUBT: no arsenic source in the pack (no realgar/cobaltite), so gallium arsenide (SMD diodes, diodes, silicon boules) is currently unobtainable.
desc:
&aSMD Diodes&r need fine &aPlatinum&r wire and Gallium Arsenide.

Platinum comes from the &dPlatinum Group Sludge&r: react purified Tetrahedrite ore with Nitric Acid in a Chemical Reactor, centrifuge the sludge with Aqua Regia, and electrolyze the raw Platinum dust.

&l&3Lore:&r&o The SMD Inductors make an appearance in GTCEu for the first time. It's more consistent and convenient to have all Circuit components receive an SMD counterpart.

decisions.reason: Redundant with ore_proc.macerator_byproduct (same machine and milestone, the HV macerator's byproduct slots) in the ore processing chapter. Its filter also listed Greate's crushing wheel. If the ore_proc review drops that quest, keep this one instead with task gtceu:hv_macerator.
Rocket fuel (space travel) cut. Ammonia isn't a PGS byproduct here; verified extra sources are coal gas and fermented biomass distillation. HV chemical reactor recipe (H + N, 384 EU/t) verified.
desc:
&aAmmonia&r is &doptional&r in &6HV&r.

You may use it in the production of:
&9-&r Nitric Acid, although we don't recommend this.
&9-&r Polybenzimidazole (now THAT'S a tongue twister!) in &1IV&r.

The "least painful" recipe should be the one in the &3HV Chemical Reactor&r, from Hydrogen and Nitrogen. Make sure your &aHydrogen&r production (mostly from &aWater electrolysis&r) is enough to support the demand.

Distilling Coal Gas or Fermented Biomass also gives some &aAmmonia&r.

decisions.reason: Rocket alloy, Fluix (AE2) and Greate's mixer aren't in the pack; indium needs purified galena, which has no source. Listed HV-mixer recipes that matter here (verified 480 EU/t): ender pearl dust, cetane-boosted diesel, ultimet, lapotron dust.
desc:
You will need the &6HV&r Mixer for several important recipes:

- &5Ender Pearl Dust&r
- &eCetane Boosted Diesel&r
- The valuable &6Ultimet Alloy&r, used for &9Turbine Rotors&r and the &5EV&r Cutter
- &9Lapotron Dust&r for &5EV&r batteries

decisions.reason: Electrotine has no ore here, so the mixer (electrum + redstone) is the way to make it, the opposite of TFG's advice. Blue alloy = 1 silver + 4 electrotine (alloy smelter or mixer); EV circuits take blue alloy bolts (verified).
desc:
&aBlue Alloy&r is an excellent Cable material for &6HV&r power.

Nothing is preventing you from using it for &bMV&r power too! Make sure that you don't overvolt your machines, though.

Superconductors for &6HV&r are unlocked... later.

It's one part Silver to four parts &aElectrotine&r. Electrotine has no ore here: mix &dElectrum&r and &dRedstone&r dust in a Mixer. You'll also need Blue Alloy bolts for your first &5EV&r Circuits.

decisions.reason: Chapter intro rewritten without the Moon, rockets, space suits and AE2; Bauxite veins don't exist here. Linked to the MV chapter's HV hull quest so the chapter opens from it.
decisions.subtitle: Things are heating up
desc:
&2We hope you're getting the hang of &9GregTech&r, because now it's time to push your skills a bit further.
In this chapter, you'll unlock &eadvanced multiblocks&r and &ecomplex processes&r.

&6Your main goal for this chapter:&r craft your first &5EV&r Machine Hull.
{@pagebreak}

To craft the &5EV&r Machine Hull:
- Build your first &aCleanroom&r
- Construct a &bVacuum Freezer&r to cool hot ingots
- Process &9Rutile&r into &7Titanium&r

Along the way you'll make &dEnder Pearls&r from scratch, take on new &aChemistry&r with Fluorine and Nitric Acid, and upgrade your &6EBF coils&r.

decisions.reason: Verified: nichrome blasts at 2,700 K, 1,920 EU/t (needs EV-level power: two HV energy hatches) and its hot ingot only cools in the Vacuum Freezer (Kanthal can use the Chemical Bath). RTM coils take molten nichrome.
desc:
Your third coil alloy is here and it's essential for your next set of coils in the &6EBF&r.

As usual you will need &9128 ingots&r for 16 coils, but this time the ingots come out hot and, unlike Kanthal, they can't be cooled in a &6Chemical Bath&r. Instead, you're required to use a &6Vacuum Freezer&r.

Good news: it's actually simpler and faster.

The EBF recipe runs at &5EV&r voltage, so give your EBF two &6HV&r Energy Hatches.

You'll only be using &6Nichrome&r for these coils, but don't get too comfortable - it will return later for the next set of &5RTM Coils&r.

decisions.reason: Ad Astra rocket; no space travel in this pack.
Rocket alloy (gtceu:rocket_alloy_t1_*) is a TFG material, not in the pack; only used for rockets.
Ad Astra rocket nose cone; no space travel.
Removed the Moon/AE2/richer-ore-veins paragraph; 'Vacuum Chamber' was meant to be the Vacuum Freezer.
desc:
Well, that was quite the experience! Between the &9Rutile Processing&r line, the &5Vacuum Freezer&r, and the &5Cleanroom&r, you've uncovered a lot of new mechanics.

If your infrastructure is solid, it's time to enter &5EV&r. This complex chapter will introduce &7even more advanced systems&r and take your factory to the next level.

Ad Astra steel engine for the rocket; no space travel.

ad_astra:moon dimension; no space travel.

Ad Astra launch pad; no space travel.

decisions.title: Ultimet
desc:
&dUltimet&r is a high-performance material, providing excellent &eSpeed&r for your &bDrill&r or &bWrench&r, and makes for a &eTurbine Rotor&r with very good &bEfficiency&r.

You'll need it even if you skip the tools: the &5EV&r Cutter, the &5EV&r Rotor Holder and the casing of &5EV&r Lapotronic Batteries are all made from it. Mix Cobalt, Chromium, Nickel and Molybdenum in the &6HV&r Mixer; the ingots come out of the EBF hot, so cool them in the &dVacuum Freezer&r.

decisions.reason: Boron carbide tools and dust are TFG items (tfg:*); not in the pack.
Rocket alloy turbine rotor; rocket alloy isn't in the pack (the task is a bare turbine rotor).

Ad Astra desh (lunar ore); not in the pack.

decisions.title: Large Steam Turbine
desc:
The &eLarge Steam Turbine&r is a very powerful &bMultiblock&r for generating power at &6HV&r. Single-block generators stop at the &6HV&r Steam Turbine, so if you plan to keep using steam power beyond that, you will need to invest in this multiblock.

It takes an &6HV&r Rotor Holder with a Turbine Rotor inside and outputs through a Dynamo Hatch. To understand how turbines work, refer to the power chapter.
